title: Nightly Excel export
body: Every day we struggle with our accounting software - it's very frustrating and wastes so much staff time.

title: Invois perlu hantar manual
body: Kami hantar invois setiap hari secara manual dan sangat kecewa sebab kos tinggi.
_note: workflow_manual_process was added when the eight keywordless topics were filled in. 'secara manual' ('manually') is a true positive, not over-matching: sending invoices by hand every day is both an invoice-delivery problem and a manual-workflow one, and config/topics.yaml states that a document may match more than one topic.

title: 库存对账问题
body: 每天对账真的非常糟糕,库存出错,浪费很多人力。

title: Inventory reconciliation trouble
body: Boss cakap stock wrong lagi, kena reconcile manual entry setiap hari, memang problem besar.
_note: Same reason as ms_invoice_delivery: 'manual entry' is exactly what workflow_manual_process describes.
